item.title: Walmart to introduce Apple Pay and other contactless payments
item.description: Walmart announced that select stores and Sam's Club locations will add tap-to-pay options in the U.S. starting Monday.

item.title: Supreme Court allows Trump's ballroom construction to proceed for now
item.description: The Supreme Court ruled Friday that President Trump's ballroom project can continue for now, despite a lower court's order that had temporarily blocked it.

item.title: MAHA warns Trump against coal-powered AI data centers
item.description: Leaders of the Make America Healthy Again movement are cautioning President Trump that data centers should not be used as a reason to expand coal power.

item.title: A roadmap for safeguarding against AI bioweapons
item.description: AI-enabled bioweapons pose a serious but manageable threat if government, scientists, public health officials, and industry collaborate on safeguards.
